title: Jumanji: The Next Level
desc: After Spencer goes missing, his team of confidantes comes back to Jumanji to go to the undiscovered regions and support him in escaping the world's most lethal game.

desc: Five friends decide to spend a weekend in a remote cabin located deep in the forest. When they accidentally summon a dormant demon, they strive to survive its evil ploys.

desc: After his father's death, Britt inherits the largest media company in Los Angeles. He teams up with Kato to fight crime but ends up becoming the target of a gangster, Benjamin Chudnofsky.

desc: Agent M, a probationary member of the MIB, teams up with Agent H and uncovers a sinister plot that reveals a traitor in the organisation aiding an alien invasion.

desc: Three delinquents break into the house of Norman, a Gulf War veteran who is visually impaired, to steal his money. However, they discover that Norman is not as helpless as he seems.

desc: Gabriel Yulaw travels to parallel universes and starts killing alternate versions of himself in order to absorb their energy and become a godlike being.

title: Django Unchained
desc: When Django, a slave, is freed, he joins forces with a bounty hunter to rescue his wife, who has been enslaved by Calvin, a hard-hearted plantation owner.

title: Man vs. Wild
desc: In Patagonia, Bear skins a hare, scales a cliff, tracks a puma, drinks dirty water and crosses the Perito Moreno Glacier, a labyrinth of ice caves and crevasses.

title: Man vs. Wild
desc: Bear paraglides into the Rockies, traverses huge waterfalls and navigates deep gullies before leaping onto a moving train.

title: Man vs. Wild
desc: In the icy weather of Patagonia, the survival expert reveals the hidden dangers that make survival so difficult and demonstrates how to build a snow cave.

title: Man vs. Wild
desc: Bear is cast into the Panama Sea and quickly reaches the coast, where he builds a raft and distils saltwater for drinking. However, a violent storm threatens to sink his boat.

title: Man vs. Wild
desc: On his next expedition to nature's kitchen, Bear Grylls resorts to drinking liquid from a camel's stomach while devouring whatever wild food he can put in his mouth.
